policies.name: Medical Nutrition Therapy (MNT) Act (H.R. 6199 / S. 3934)
policies.status: Introduced in Committee (119th Congress ends Jan 3, 2027)
policies.summary: H.R. 6199 (Rep. Robin Kelly, D-IL) and S. 3934 (Sens. Collins & Peters) expand Medicare Part B MNT beyond diabetes and renal disease to include obesity, prediabetes, hypertension, dyslipidemia, cancer, CVD, HIV/AIDS, GI/celiac disease, malnutrition, and eating disorders. Also authorizes NPs, PAs, CNSs, and psychologists to refer.
policies.so_what: Unlikely to pass before the 119th Congress adjourns on Jan 3, 2027 due to lack of CBO score; expect reintroduction in early 2027 (120th Congress).
spicerack_recommendations: Enroll the Spicerack PLLC and each individual RD in Medicare now to build billing workflows and capture existing Medicare MNT revenue for diabetes and renal patients.
Build a direct local advocacy relationship with Rep. Robin Kelly's office (IL-02, bill sponsor) and the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics advocacy team.
Prepare administrative workflows for referral documentation and expanded ICD-10 diagnosis coding ahead of 120th Congress reintroduction in January 2027.

policies.name: Dietitian Licensure Compact
policies.summary: Interstate compact allowing RDs/RDNs with an unencumbered license in a member home state to practice across member states via a 'compact privilege'. Enacted in 19 states (AL, NE, TN, AR, IA, KS, MS, MT, ND, OH, OK, RI, SD, UT, WI, GA, KY, MO, WA). Privileges expected in 2027. Illinois has not introduced a bill yet.
policies.so_what: No compact privileges are issued yet, and Illinois is not yet a member state. The compact only covers individual RD licensure—not PLLC corporate entity qualification.
spicerack_recommendations: Limit near-term state expansion to non-licensure or low-barrier states until compact privileges officially issue in 2027.
Verify foreign entity qualification and professional ownership rules in each target state to confirm an Illinois-licensed PLLC can legally operate there.
Build a state-by-state Practice Act compliance guide for Spicerack RDs; practitioners remain legally responsible for remote state scope of practice.
Recruit RDs residing in the 19 enacted compact member states so they can immediately leverage multi-state compact privileges once issued in 2027, and advocate for an Illinois compact bill.

policies.name: Medicare Telehealth Policy (CAA 2026 / H.R. 7148)
policies.summary: The Consolidated Appropriations Act of 2026 (H.R. 7148, Feb 2026) extended Medicare telehealth flexibilities through December 31, 2027 and retroactively covered the post-Jan 30, 2026 lapse. Distant-site RD eligibility and MNT CPT codes on the Telehealth List are permanent, but the home originating-site waiver expires Dec 31, 2027.
policies.so_what: Home-based Medicare MNT telehealth is secure through 2027, but if Congress fails to pass an extension by Dec 31, 2027, patients must travel to rural qualifying clinical sites.
spicerack_recommendations: Diversify Spicerack's payer mix with commercial payers and value-based B2B contracts now so post-2027 revenue is not solely dependent on Medicare extensions.
Maintain strict intake and clinical documentation of patient physical location at every visit to satisfy state laws and potential post-2027 Medicare audits.
Remember that federal Medicare telehealth waivers do not override state-level licensure or state telehealth practice standards.

policies.name: CMS ACCESS Model
policies.summary: 10-year CMMI model supporting virtual and asynchronous chronic care for Original Medicare. Launched July 2026 (150 orgs); expanded Sept 15, 2026. Features monthly billing codes (G0669 at $30/mo for eCKM; G0671 at $35/mo for CKM) with 50% held back for year-end outcome benchmarks. Medicare pays 80%, patient owes 20% coinsurance.
policies.so_what: Pays for obesity and prediabetes, but at $30-$35/month max, reimbursement is far below standard 15-minute RD fee-for-service. Only technology/AI-driven asynchronous models can sustain margins; 100% live RD 1-on-1 care will lose money under ACCESS.
spicerack_recommendations: Position Spicerack's AI monitoring and asynchronous messaging platform to handle the day-to-day engagement required under G0669/G0671, reserving high-cost RD hours for intake and escalation.
Model financial projections accounting for the 50% year-end outcome holdback and 20% patient coinsurance collection risk.
Complete the CMS ACCESS rolling interest form focused on the eCKM (obesity, prediabetes) and CKM tracks.

policies.name: CMS LEAD Model
policies.summary: 10-year successor to ACO REACH (Jan 1, 2027 - Dec 31, 2036) with Global (100%) and Professional (50%) risk tracks and primary/total care capitation. Participating ACOs must have at least 5,000 aligned Original Medicare beneficiaries. Dietitians receive 85% of the Physician Fee Schedule under 42 C.F.R. § 414.64.
policies.so_what: LEAD ACOs bear downside financial risk and can use capitation dollars to pay Spicerack a predictable PMPM or case rate to deliver nutrition interventions for non-diabetic obesity that Medicare FFS excludes.
spicerack_recommendations: Target published LEAD ACO participant lists in Illinois and expansion states with at least 5,000 aligned beneficiaries.
Pitch LEAD ACOs a predictable PMPM or case-rate contract for chronic disease management, highlighting the 3-hour Year 1 / 2-hour Year 2 FFS equivalent cap ($250-$400/pt/yr) as a benchmark.
Emphasize that clinical nutrition reduces preventable admissions and helps ACOs earn their 50%-100% shared savings.

policies.name: CMS BALANCE Model
policies.impact_area: Payment Model, Pharma B2B Partnerships, GLP-1 Wrap-Around
policies.summary: Announced Dec 23, 2025 under SSA § 1115A. Mandates participating GLP-1 manufacturers provide evidence-based lifestyle and nutrition support. State Medicaid agencies can join through Jan 1, 2027 (Illinois status unconfirmed). RDs cannot bill CMS directly; revenue comes solely from pharma vendor contracts.
policies.so_what: Spicerack cannot apply to CMS to bill BALANCE directly. Revenue is entirely determined by what pharmaceutical company contracts offer, and manufacturers may favor lower-cost AI wrap-arounds over live clinical staffing.
spicerack_recommendations: Pitch pharma partners (Novo Nordisk, Eli Lilly) a hybrid model pairing Spicerack's AI tracking platform with licensed RD telehealth support.
Apply directly via Novo Nordisk Digital Partnerships and Eli Lilly Supplier Development portals.
Track Illinois Department of Healthcare and Family Services (HFS) for an official BALANCE State RFA submission prior to Jan 1, 2027.
